info.title: Starcom WebOrder API
info.description:
The Starcom WebOrder API enables external client applications to search products,
manage a shopping cart, and submit purchase orders without using the WebOrder
frontend UI.

## Who this is for
Partners and customers who want **API-only** access to build custom ordering
experiences or back-office integrations.

## Base URL
- Production/Sandbox: http://weborder.plantpartnertrials.com

## Authentication
- HTTP Basic Auth (username + password) on protected endpoints.
- Include credentials via the `Authorization: Basic <base64(username:password)>` header.

## Typical flow
1) Discover available products and criteria
   - `GET /api/v1/products/search-params`
   - `POST /api/v1/products/search`
   - `POST /api/v1/products/availability`
2) Build the cart
   - `PUT /api/v1/cart` to set order date and items
   - `POST /api/v1/cart/search` to read the current cart snapshot
   - `DELETE /api/v1/cart/products?ids=...` to remove specific items
3) Place the order
   - `POST /api/v1/orders` to commit/submit the order
4) Account & Settings
   - `POST /api/v1/users/sign-up`, `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `GET /api/v1/auth/logout`
   - `GET /api/v1/users/extract` for the current user profile
   - `GET /api/v1/settings` and `GET /api/v1/settings/customer` for configuration

put.summary: Update cart (set order date and items)
put.description:
Replaces the current cart contents with the provided order date and product lines.

**Use when**: You want to define the cart's order date and add/update all items in a single call.

**Request body**: `UpdateCartRequest`
- `orderDate` (date): targeted ship/order date for pricing and availability.
- `products[]` (array of `ProductCart`): each entry includes `productId`, `packageId`, `quantity`,
  and optional `kit`/`oversell`.

**Returns**: `200 OK` if the cart is successfully updated. To read the cart snapshot (totals, items),
call `POST /api/v1/cart/search`.

requestBody.description: New cart definition including the order date and the full set of cart items.

200.description: Cart updated successfully. Use `/api/v1/cart/search` to retrieve the current snapshot.

delete.description:
Removes **all** items from the current cart.

**Returns**: `200 OK` after the cart is emptied.

post.description:
Registers a new end user for WebOrder.

**Request body**: `CreateUserRequest` with contact info and credentials
(e.g., `username`, `password`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `phone`, `companyName`).

**Returns**: `201 Created` on success.

requestBody.description: Registration payload containing user credentials and company/contact details.

post.description:
Searches the product catalog with optional free-text query and filters.

**Request body**: `SearchProductsRequest`
- `query.orderDate` (date, required): the context date to evaluate inventory/pricing.
- `query.search` (string): free-text (e.g., SKU, name).
- `query.categoryIds` (array[int]): filter by categories.
- `query.baseAvailabilityCriteria` (int): inventory criteria to apply.
- `navigation` (page/size/sorts): pagination and sorting options.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `SearchProductsResponse` containing a `products[]` list and `page` pagination info.

requestBody.description: Search criteria (query + pagination/sorting) for locating products.

200.description: Product search results, including items and pagination.

post.description:
Returns availability quantities (and optional comments) for the given product IDs.

**Request body**: `AvailabilityRequest`
- `items[]` (array[int]): product IDs to check.
- `baseAvailCritId` (int): availability criteria to apply.
- `forDate` (string): date context for availability.
- `comments` (bool): include availability comments if `true`.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `GetProductsAvailabilityResponse` containing `availability` details by product.

requestBody.description: The list of product IDs and options used to compute current availability.

200.description: Availability information for the requested products.

post.description:
Submits the current cart as an order with shipping/billing details.

**Request body**: `OrderCommitRequest`
- Required: `shipViaId`
- Optional: `extraPurchaseOrderNumber`, `placedBy`, `email`, `phone`,
  `shipAddress`, `billingAddress`, `orderDate`.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `OrderCommitResponse` containing the generated `orderNumber`.

requestBody.description: Order submission payload including shipping method and contact/addresses.

post.description:
Returns the current cart with items, totals, and pagination-ready product list.

**Request body**: `GetCartRequest` (optional `navigation` to page through items).

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `SearchCartProductsResponse` containing `cart` details and `page` pagination.

requestBody.description: Optional pagination configuration to page through the cart's product list.

200.description: Current cart contents and totals with pagination info.

post.description:
Completes a password reset using a valid reset token (obtained via "forgot password").

**Request body**: `ResetPasswordRequest` with `username`, `token` (exact length 50), and `passwordReset` (new password + confirmation).

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `SuccessResponse` message if the password was updated.

requestBody.description: Username, reset token, and new password to finalize a password reset.

post.description:
Initiates a password reset by sending a reset token to the user's registered contact channel.

**Request body**: `ForgotPasswordRequest` with `username`.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `SuccessResponse` message if the reset process was initiated.

requestBody.description: Username of the account requesting a password reset.

post.description:
Authenticates a user with `username` and `password`.

**Request body**: `LoginRequest` (`username`, `password`, optional `origin`).

**Returns**: `200 OK` on successful authentication.

get.description:
Returns public information about the currently authenticated user.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `UserResponse`.

Returns global UI/ordering settings that can inform client behavior and display.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `SettingResponse` (e.g., `uiSetting`, `orderSetting`, `shippingOptions`).

Returns settings specific to the current company, including order and shipping defaults.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `CompanySettingResponse` (e.g., `orderSetting`, `shippingSetting`).

Returns the available search criteria, programs, and categories to help build rich product filters.

**Returns**: `200 OK` with `ProductSearchCriteriaResponse`.

Ends the current authenticated session.

**Returns**: `200 OK` after logout.

delete.description:
Removes one or more cart line items by their **cart item IDs**.

**Query parameters**
- `ids` (array[int], required): list of cart line item IDs to remove.

**Returns**: `200 OK` once the specified items are deleted.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: One or more cart **item IDs** to remove. Provide as repeated `ids` parameters or as a comma-separated list depending on client.

oversell.description: Indicates that the grower is willing to accept orders for that product even if they currently have no available inventory.
